name: counterpress-left
reply:
What I saw
- Counterpressing scenario in the opponent's defensive third (final third) after losing possession in an 11v11 setup.
- Matchup of ATT 4-3-3 against DEF 4-2-3-1.

On the board
- Placed the action in the opponent's defensive third with the nearest three ATT pressers swarming the ball.
- Displayed the immediate 3-5 second counterpress to force a negative touch or regain possession.
- Maintained ATT shape with higher lines and central compactness for rest defense.

Coaching points
- Apply immediate pressure on the ball-carrier within 3 to 5 seconds of losing possession to deny an easy outlet pass.
- The nearest three players form a pressing triangle to cut off passing lanes while supporting defenders step up.
- Keep vertical and horizontal compactness to ensure we win second balls if the initial press is bypassed.
